chaining: the voucher is spent before the top-up balance, so a mainland account runs on it first and then on paid balance

free_tier.stated: An RMB 15 voucher granted on registration, valid for 3 months from issue, only for new users who register with a mainland China mobile number. It is applied automatically and deducted before the top-up balance. With a zero balance after the voucher, API requests return a 403 error. No free grant for a registration outside mainland China is stated on the page read

limits.value: RMB 15 voucher, expires 3 months after issue; afterwards requests need a top-up balance or return 403

binding_note: the voucher is small and time-boxed, and it is granted only to mainland mobile registrations

identity_cost.detail: the voucher is granted to new users who register with a mainland China mobile number
